name: Kent Metal Fabrication LLC.
old_description: Taking care of all your metal fabrication needs for a great price, fast turnaround and amazing quality!
about:
Kent Metal Fabrication operates from Scottsdale, Arizona. The business was founded by an unnamed owner who had been in the metal fabrication trade since 1998, including over a decade at the family-owned Custom Metal Company. After Custom Metal Cutting was acquired, the owner launched Kent Metal Fabrication to offer custom and production metalwork across the Southwest.

The shop provides a range of fabrication services including welding, plasma cutting, sawing, shearing, torching, drilling, bending on a 100-ton hydraulic press, notching, punching, and custom fabrication. It handles both one-off prototypes and low- to high-volume production runs, and also offers mobile welding and repair work for equipment, trailers, fences, and furniture. The facility is equipped with a hydraulic press brake, a plasma cutting table, and notching equipment.

Customers come from sectors such as equipment maintenance, trailer manufacturing, fencing, and furniture production. The company emphasizes quick turnaround and competitive pricing, and it offers a 10–25% discount on first orders to new clients.

The founder cites quality of work, sense of urgency, and pricing as the factors that set the business apart, with a goal of becoming a leading metal fabrication provider in Arizona and the broader Southwest region.
